purpose: Test the frozen v14 model-length accounting, recoverable output classification, and expanded completion allocation on the same consumed Q10 identity used by replay v1.

trigger_evidence.synthetic_stress_probe_result: 5/5 parsed candidates with stop finish; zero request or policy errors

official_protocol.access: post-episode only after an internal pass

primary_outcomes: completed responses, parsed candidates, request errors, and token usage
secondary_outcomes: internal pass and natural Official evaluator reach

decision_rule.practical_output_qualification: At least five completed responses produce parsed candidates, and the run contains no candidate-policy-output failure, empty-final diagnostic, or request error.
decision_rule.length_accounting_qualification: If a length-finished provider response occurs, it increments responses_completed and token usage, is recorded as candidate-policy-output with finish_reason=length, and is never a request error or candidate-policy-exception.
decision_rule.budget_terminal_qualification: If the online budget terminates the run, the terminal failure is episode-budget-exhausted with its exact scope and no budget message is classified as candidate-policy-exception.
decision_rule.contradicted: Any empty-final policy failure under the frozen contract, usage-bearing length finish counted as request error or policy exception, persisted reasoning content, or budget exhaustion classified as a policy exception blocks unseen qualification.
decision_rule.unexercised: An earlier internal Pass, infrastructure Unknown, or provider exception before five parsed responses prevents the practical boundary from being observed; report without replacement.

adaptation_policy.pre_episode_acquisition_failure: one audited same-identity retry only when model, candidate, environment, command, and evaluator usage are all zero
adaptation_policy.other_failure: record the observed outcome without retry or adaptation
